title: Cozy Getaway | Close to DT Nash & Germantown!
description:
✔️ Salemtown location — minutes to Downtown and Germantown
✔️ Private fenced backyard with outdoor lounge seating
✔️ 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom — sleeps up to 4
✔️ Open-concept living with smart TV
✔️ Full kitchen with island seating for 4
✔️ Private laundry and dedicated workspace

The space
• Cozy ranch-style home designed for couples, families, and weekend getaways
• Open living room with smart TV and comfortable seating
• Full kitchen with island seating for 4 and everything needed for simple meals
• Private fenced backyard with outdoor sectional and lounge seating
• Perfect for couples, small families, business travelers, and extended stays

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open-concept living room with smart TV
• Private fully fenced backyard
• Outdoor sectional and additional patio seating
• Bright, single-level home with modern finishes

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 4)
• This home includes 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom.
• Bedroom 1 — Queen bed
• Bedroom 2 — Queen bed
• Bath — Single vanity with shower/tub combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and basic cookware/serveware
• Coffee maker, blender, and toaster
• Large island seating 4
• Cookware, bakeware, dishes, utensils, wine glasses, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private washer and dryer
• High-speed WiFi
• Dedicated workspace
• Smart TV
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• Located in Salemtown near Germantown restaurants, cafés, and breweries
• Approximately 1.6 miles to Downtown Nashville and Broadway
• Approximately 1 mile to Bicentennial Capitol Mall State Park and the Nashville Farmers' Market
• Minutes to First Horizon Park, Tennessee State Museum, Morgan Park, and the Cumberland River Greenway
• Walk to local favorite Big Al's Deli

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Street parking only on a first-come, first-served basis. There are no dedicated or reserved spaces.
• This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check-out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
